name: AUIA Audit Accessibility
author: auiaema

sections.description:
AUIA-audit-accessibility helps you detect, understand and improve accessibility issues on your WordPress website in a simple and effective way.

Once activated, the plugin performs a complete accessibility audit of your site, analyzing both content and structure according to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

Key features

  • WCAG Accessibility Audit
    Analyze your website against applicable WCAG criteria and detect accessibility errors such as contrast issues, missing alternative text, structural problems and more.

  • Detailed Reports
    Get clear and structured reports that identify accessibility issues, highlight what is already compliant and help you prioritize improvements.

  • Support
    Access a support channel to resolve questions or issues related to the plugin and web accessibility.

Freemium model

AUIA-audit-accessibility follows a freemium model. The free version allows users to get an initial overview of their site’s accessibility and identify main issues. Advanced features such as unlimited audits, premium support and higher performance are available in paid plans.

This plugin is designed for developers, agencies, content editors and organizations that want to move towards a more inclusive, accessible and regulation-compliant web.

External services

This plugin relies on a third-party API service to perform accessibility audits and generate reports.

AUIA Accessibility Analysis API

The plugin sends page data (URL, HTML content, detected accessibility violations and computed styles) to the AUIA analysis API in order to generate detailed WCAG accessibility reports.

Data is sent when the user explicitly triggers an accessibility audit from the plugin’s admin panel. No data is sent automatically or without user action.

  • Service provider: Basetis (https://www.basetis.com)
  • API endpoint: https://auditoria-api.basetis.com
  • Terms of use: https://auia-accesibility.basetis.com/es/terminos-y-condiciones/
  • Privacy policy: https://auia-accesibility.basetis.com/es/politica-de-privacidad-plugin/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/auia-audit-accessibility directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the AUIA menu in your WordPress admin panel.
  4. Create a free account or log in to get your API credentials.
  5. Run your first accessibility audit from the plugin dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin automatically fix accessibility issues?

No. The plugin detects and explains accessibility issues, helping you understand what needs to be fixed and why, but changes must be applied manually.

Which accessibility guidelines are supported?

The plugin analyzes your site according to the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG).

Is this plugin suitable for non-technical users?

Yes. Reports, live analysis and the chatbot are designed to be understandable even for users without technical background.

Does the free version have limitations?

The plugin code is fully functional and not limited in any way. The number of accessibility audits you can run is controlled by the external AUIA API service: the free tier provides a limited monthly quota, while paid plans on the AUIA service allow higher quotas and additional capabilities. No plugin feature is locked behind a paywall.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release of AUIA Audit Accessibility.
  • WCAG-based accessibility audits via the AUIA API.
  • Detailed per-page reports with WCAG A/AA/AAA classification.
  • Async analysis with polling and progress indicator.
  • Account page with license activation and credits overview.
